description: A Svelte 5 data grid gallery over 5,000 rows. The cards are drawn in batches of 120 as the wall scrolls, so the first paint costs the same as a small table; search narrows all 5,000 rows and starts the wall from the top. The cover is a computed column, drawn per card from the row.

faq.question: Does the gallery mount every card?
faq.answer: No. It draws the first 120 cards and adds the next 120 a little before the end of the wall comes into view. A new search or filter starts again from the first batch.

faq.question: Can the cover be computed instead of stored?
faq.answer: Yes. coverField can name a column with a fieldFn; the gallery reads its value per row, so the rows here hold a hue and the image is drawn from it when its card is drawn.
